comment: The AAD token endpoint refusing an expired client secret — the response body ClientSecretCredential embeds into the ClientAuthenticationError it raises, so this is what an expiry actually looks like from inside a run. AADSTS7000222 is the code that means 'rotate it'; the outcome is AUTH_EXPIRED, distinct from AUTH_FAILED (Req 12.13, 19.6). No request is ever issued on this path, which is why the permissions transport must record zero requests when it is replayed.
